    Rick Pitino has been the head coach at St. John's
    since being hired on March 20, 2023. As of March 2026, he has completed three seasons (2023–24, 2024–25, and 2025–26) with the Red Storm, quickly revitalizing the program. 
    • Hired: March 20, 2023
    • Tenure: 2023–present (currently in his 3rd season as of March 2026)
    • Contract: Signed a six-year deal
    • Preceding Tenure: Spent three seasons at Iona (2020–2023) before joining St. John's 
    In his first three seasons (covering the 2023–24 through 2025–26 seasons), he has led the team back to national prominence.
